text: My next appointment is in Hadera, which is now my assigned office after I moved from Jerusalem. I uploaded all the required documents in October 2025, but we only received an appointment for March 2026, after my visa had already expired — and only after we emailed in January to ask about the status of the case. Due to the war, that appointment was later cancelled and my visa (a5) automatically extended until June, and despite several attempts to contact them by email to reschedule the appointment, we have had no response so far☹️
